title: Risāla ilā Yūliyānūs fī l-siyāsa ('Letter/Oration to the Emperor on Government'); RU: Фемистий, «Послание к Юлиану об управлении государством»
author: Themistius
date: 4th c. CE (addressee debated); Arabic translation 9th–10th c.
edition: Arabic text with Latin by I. Shahîd in Themistii Orationes III (Teubner 1974; not re-verified); Swain 2013. No public-domain Arabic text.
ru_evidence: ru.wiki «Фемистий» lists Russian translations only of Orations 3, 12, 30 (Егунов 1961) and 25, 27 (Грабарь-Пассек 1964). Solopova 2018 lists no Russian translation of the Arabic Themistius.
en_evidence: Swain, Themistius, Julian, and Greek Political Theory under Rome: Texts, Translations and Studies of Four Key Works (CUP 2013).
value: A Greek theory of kingship lost in Greek. Key for Late Antique imperial ideology (Julian–Themistius) and for early Arabic political thought.
ai_feasibility: High (Arabic). Swain's and Shahîd's versions are available for cross-checking.
